conditions: The character data is part of the document content actually processed, after applicable input normalization. Data in entity replacement text is in scope when the text is included.
limitations: Under §4.4.3, an XML processor that is not validating may omit replacement text for a recognized external parsed entity reference covered by that clause. If it omits the replacement text, it must notify the application that the entity was recognized and unread.

Under §5.1, validating processors read and process the entire DTD and referenced external parsed entities. The source separately specifies the obligatory processing of declarations read by non-validating processors.
Section 2.11 normalizes literal line endings before parsing. Section 2.10 also requires validating processors to identify white space in element content.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: During normal processing under XML 1.0 Fifth Edition, an XML processor must pass the non-markup character data it processes in the document content to the application, including such data in entity replacement text it includes.
